summary: Washer Temps E2E tested — backend (13/13 pytest pass) + frontend Playwright flow on mobile viewport. Tile no longer 'Coming Soon'; full Add → Wash (55°C, green ≥55) → Rinse (82°C, green ≥82) → Comment → Submit flow works and shows 'Washer passed!' card with washer name + both ✓ temps. /rinse direct-nav redirect to /wash verified. Backend asserts wash_pass when wash_temp>=55, rinse_pass when rinse_temp>=82, passed=both, 404 for unknown washer_id, all responses exclude _id, auth-gated CRUD enforced.

integration_issues.flow: Picker reload via page.goto right after /comment redirect produced ~70 spurious 403s on /api/admin/washers (likely because LocationContext rehydrated after first render so adminLocationId was empty/undefined for first call). Possible real fix: PickWasher should guard the API call until adminLocationId is truthy AND skip the alert toast on first transient empty state. Did not block the user E2E — issue only reproduced via direct goto in test harness.

action_items: (Optional) PickWasher.jsx: skip the api.washersList() call when adminLocationId is undefined/empty and avoid alert() on transient empty state — this caused noisy 403s in the test harness when navigating directly to /jkhive/washer-temps before LocationContext settled.
(Optional) Standardize to 401 (not 403) when JWT missing/expired so the api.fetch() auto-refresh path is exercised (currently get_staff_or_above appears to return 403).
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/routes/washers.py is clean (excludes _id everywhere, validates name, enforces wash>=55 / rinse>=82 thresholds, returns 404 for missing washer_id).
Frontend AddWasher.jsx: 'Save & Record' uses navigate(..., { replace: true }) so the back button skips the new screen — correct pattern.
RinseTemp.jsx state-missing redirect to /wash works as expected (verified).
seed_data_creation: Test washer 'Test Dishwasher' (id=282307cb-e41) created during E2E and cleaned up after.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_washers.py (13 tests, all green). Mobile-viewport Playwright flow validated full happy path with screenshots showing wash gauge default 55 with green color, rinse gauge default 82 with green color, and pass card showing 'Test Dishwasher · Wash 55.0°C (✓) · Rinse 82.0°C (✓)'. Note: clicking the MoreRoutines tile via the testid wrapper element didn't trigger nav (Tile uses internal <Link>, so click the inner <a> or use navigate/goto). Edit/Delete UI was not fully validated via Playwright due to a post-redirect 403 cascade; backend covers update_name + delete tests.
rca of the issue: No blocking issue. Spurious 403s observed on picker reload after a direct goto stem from PickWasher firing api.washersList() before LocationContext finishes rehydrating adminLocationId — the GET goes out with location_id=undefined and the staff-gate returns 403. User-flow does not hit this because normal navigation keeps context intact.
